translations.literal: That year Zongxian in prefectural examination, provincial examination, and palace examination all ranked first—called "Meng the Four Firsts"; contemporary opinion held that Boren knew literature.
translations.idiomatic: That year Zongxian took first in the prefectural, provincial, and palace examinations and was called "Meng the Four Firsts"; contemporaries agreed that Boren truly knew literary talent.

sentences.zh: 故事，狀元官從七品，階承務郎，世宗以宗獻獨異等，與從六品，階授奉直大夫。

translations.literal: By precedent the top graduate's office was seventh rank, rank Gentleman for Court Service; Shizong because Zongxian alone was of exceptional grade gave sixth rank, rank Gentleman for Direct Service.
translations.idiomatic: By precedent the top graduate received seventh rank and the rank of Gentleman for Court Service; Shizong, finding Zongxian uniquely outstanding, granted sixth rank and the rank of Gentleman for Direct Service.

sentences.zh: 改著作郎。

translations.literal: He was changed to Composition Gentleman.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed composition gentleman.

sentences.zh: 居母喪，服除，調鎮西節度副使。

translations.literal: Dwelling in mourning for his mother, when mourning ended he was assigned vice military commissioner of Zhenxi.
translations.idiomatic: After mourning his mother he was assigned vice military commissioner of the Zhenxi circuit.

sentences.zh: 入為起居注兼左拾遺，上書論時務六事。

translations.literal: He entered as Diurnal Record compiler concurrently Left Reminder, memorializing on six matters of current affairs.
translations.idiomatic: He entered court as compiler of the imperial diary and left reminder and memorialized on six matters of state.

sentences.zh: 改大名少尹。

translations.literal: He was changed to Junior Prefect of Daming.
translations.idiomatic: He was made junior prefect of Daming.

sentences.zh: 郡中豪民橫恣甚，莫可制，民受其害，伯仁窮竟渠黨，四境帖然。

translations.literal: In the prefecture powerful locals were very overbearing and violent, none could control them, the people suffered their harm; Boren thoroughly investigated their gangs, and the four borders were settled.
translations.idiomatic: Powerful locals in the prefecture ran rampant beyond control and harmed the people; Boren investigated their gangs to the end, and the region was pacified.

sentences.zh: 讞館陶大辟，得其冤狀，館陶人為立祠。

translations.literal: In judging a capital case in Guantao he obtained its wrongful circumstances; the Guantao people erected a shrine for him.
translations.idiomatic: In a capital case at Guantao he uncovered a wrongful conviction, and the people of Guantao erected a shrine in his honor.

sentences.zh: 府尹荊王文坐贓削封，降德州防禦使，同知裴滿子甯及伯仁、判官謝奴皆以不能匡正解職。

translations.literal: Prefect Jing Wangwen sat guilty of embezzlement and lost his enfeoffment, demoted to Dedezhou defense commissioner; Vice Commissioner Peiman Zining together with Boren and administrative aide Xie Nu all because of inability to correct were dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Prefect Jing Wangwen was stripped of his enfeoffment for corruption and demoted to defense commissioner of Dezhou; vice commissioner Peiman Zining, Boren, and administrative aide Xie Nu were all dismissed for failing to correct him.

sentences.zh: 伯仁降南京留守判官，改同知安化軍節度使，到官三日，召為太子右諭德、兼侍御史，改翰林待制，複兼右諭德。

translations.literal: Boren was demoted to Nanjing garrison administrative aide, changed to vice commissioner of Anhua Army, three days after reaching his post summoned as Crown Prince Right Mentor, concurrently Attending Censor, changed to Hanlin Awaiting Draftsman, again concurrently Right Mentor.
translations.idiomatic: Boren was demoted to administrative aide to the Nanjing garrison commander, then made vice commissioner of the Anhua army; three days after taking office he was recalled as right mentor to the crown prince and attending censor, then Hanlin awaiting draftsman, again concurrently right mentor.

sentences.zh: 除濱州刺史。

translations.literal: He was appointed Prefect of Binzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed prefect of Binzhou.

sentences.zh: 郡俗有遣奴出亡，捕之以規賞者，伯仁至，責其主而杖殺其奴，如是者數輩，其弊遂止。

translations.literal: The prefectural custom had sending slaves out to flee, then capturing them to seek reward; when Boren arrived he reproached the masters and beat the slaves to death; such cases numbered several groups—the abuse then stopped.
translations.idiomatic: Local custom encouraged masters to let slaves escape and then capture them for reward; Boren punished the masters and executed the slaves in several such cases, and the abuse ceased.

sentences.zh: 入為左諫議大夫，兼禮部侍郎、翰林直學士。

translations.literal: He entered as Left Remonstrance Censor, concurrently Vice Minister of Rites and Hanlin Direct Academician.
translations.idiomatic: He entered court as left remonstrance censor, concurrently vice minister of rites and Hanlin direct academician.

sentences.zh: 故事，諫官詞臣入直禁中，上閔其勞，特免入直。

translations.literal: By precedent remonstrance officials and literary ministers entered duty in the forbidden precinct; the emperor pitied their labor and specially exempted them from entering duty.
translations.idiomatic: By precedent remonstrance officials and literary ministers kept night duty in the palace; the emperor, pitying his labors, specially exempted him.

sentences.zh: 改吏部侍郎，直學士如故。

translations.literal: He was changed to Vice Minister of Personnel; direct academician as before.
translations.idiomatic: He was made vice minister of personnel while retaining his post as direct academician.

sentences.zh: 鄭子聃卒，宰相舉伯仁代之，乃遷待講兼禮部侍郎。

translations.literal: When Zheng Zidan died the chief ministers recommended Boren to replace him; he was then transferred to Attendant Lecturer concurrently Vice Minister of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: When Zheng Zidan died, the chief ministers recommended Boren to replace him, and he was promoted to attendant lecturer concurrently vice minister of rites.

sentences.zh: 伯仁久在翰林，文詞典麗，上曰：「自韓昉、張鈞後，則有翟永固，近日則張景仁、鄭子聃，今則伯仁而已，其次未見能文者。

translations.literal: Boren long in the Hanlin, his literary words canonical and beautiful; the emperor said: "Since Han Fang and Zhang Jun, then there was Zhai Yonggu; recently Zhang Jingren and Zheng Zidan; now only Boren—among the rest I have not seen those able in prose.
translations.idiomatic: Boren had long served in the Hanlin, and his writing was elegant and accomplished; the emperor said, "After Han Fang and Zhang Jun came Zhai Yonggu; recently Zhang Jingren and Zheng Zidan; now only Boren remains—I see no other capable writer among them.

sentences.zh: 呂忠翰草《降海陵庶人詔》，點竄再四，終不能盡朕意，狀元雖以詞賦甲天下，至於辭命，未必皆能。

translations.literal: Lü Zhonghan drafted the "Edict Demoting Hailing the Commoner," revising again and again, yet in the end could not exhaust my intent; the top graduate though with rhapsodies and fu first under Heaven, as for rescripts and commands, not necessarily all can do it.
translations.idiomatic: Lü Zhonghan drafted the edict demoting Hailing to commoner status and revised it repeatedly, yet still failed to satisfy me; though the top graduate may lead the empire in fu and rhapsody, not every such man can draft imperial commands.

sentences.zh: 凡進士可令補外，考其能文者召用之。」

translations.literal: All jinshi may be ordered to fill external posts; examine those able in prose and summon and employ them."
translations.idiomatic: Let jinshi fill posts outside the capital first, and summon those who prove themselves capable writers."

sentences.zh: 不數月，兼左諫議大夫，俄兼太常卿。

translations.literal: Within a few months he concurrently held Left Remonstrance Censor; soon concurrently Grand Master of Ceremonies.
translations.idiomatic: Within a few months he was also made left remonstrance censor, and soon grand master of ceremonies.

sentences.zh: 大臣舉可修起居注者數人，上以伯仁領之。

translations.literal: Chief ministers recommended several who could compile the Diurnal Record; the emperor had Boren lead it.
translations.idiomatic: When chief ministers recommended several men to compile the imperial diary, the emperor put Boren in charge.

sentences.zh: 從幸上京，伯仁多病，至臨潢，地寒因感疾，還中都。

translations.literal: Following the imperial progress to the Upper Capital, Boren was often ill; reaching Linhuang, the land was cold and he contracted illness thereby, returning to the Central Capital.
translations.idiomatic: Accompanying the emperor to the Upper Capital, Boren fell ill; at Linhuang the cold brought on his illness, and he returned to the Central Capital.

sentences.zh: 明年，上還幸中都，遣使勞問，賜以丹劑。

translations.literal: The next year when the emperor returned in progress to the Central Capital, he sent envoys to comfort and inquire, bestowing cinnabar medicine.
translations.idiomatic: The following year, when the emperor returned to the Central Capital, he sent envoys to inquire after him and bestowed medicinal pellets.

sentences.zh: 是歲，卒。

translations.literal: That year he died.
translations.idiomatic: That year he died.

sentences.zh: 鄭子聃

translations.literal: Zheng Zidan.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng Zidan.

sentences.zh: 鄭子聃，字景純，大定府人。

translations.literal: Zheng Zidan, style name Jingchun, was a native of Dading Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng Zidan, whose style name was Jingchun, came from Dading prefecture.

sentences.zh: 父宏，遼金源令，二子子京、子聃。

translations.literal: His father Hong was Liao magistrate of Jinyuan; two sons Zijing and Zidan.
translations.idiomatic: His father Hong had been magistrate of Jinyuan under the Liao and had two sons, Zijing and Zidan.

sentences.zh: 楊丘行嘗謂人曰：「金源二子，鳳毛也。

translations.literal: Yang Qiuxing once said to people: "Jinyuan's two sons are phoenix down.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Qiuxing once said, "The two sons of Jinyuan are phoenix fledglings.

sentences.zh: 小者尤特達，後必名世。」

translations.literal: The younger especially is outstanding; later he will certainly make his name in the world."
translations.idiomatic: The younger is especially remarkable and will surely make his name in the world."

sentences.zh: 子聃及冠，有能賦聲。

translations.literal: When Zidan reached the capping age he had a reputation for ability in fu.
translations.idiomatic: When Zidan came of age he was already famed for his fu.

sentences.zh: 天德三年，丘行為太子左衛率府率，廷試明日，海陵以子聃程文示丘行，對曰：「可入甲乙。」

translations.literal: In the third year of Tiande Qiuxing was Left Guard of the Heir Apparent commandant; the day after the palace examination Hailing showed Zidan's examination essay to Qiuxing; he replied: "Can enter jia or yi."
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Tiande, when Qiuxing was commandant of the Left Guard of the Heir Apparent, Hailing showed him Zidan's palace examination essay the day after the test; he replied, "This can rank in the upper grades."

sentences.zh: 及拆卷，果中第一甲第三人。

translations.literal: When the papers were opened, he indeed placed third in the first jia.
translations.idiomatic: When the papers were opened, he indeed ranked third in the first jia.

sentences.zh: 調翼城丞，遷贊皇令，召為書畫直長。

translations.literal: He was assigned Yicheng assistant magistrate, transferred to Zanhuang magistrate, summoned as Direct Steward of Calligraphy and Painting.
translations.idiomatic: He was assigned assistant magistrate of Yicheng, promoted to magistrate of Zanhuang, and summoned as direct steward of calligraphy and painting.

sentences.zh: 子聃頗以才望自負，常慊不得為第一甲第一人。

translations.literal: Zidan rather prided himself on talent and reputation, often resentful at not being first person in the first jia.
translations.idiomatic: Zidan was proud of his talent and reputation and often regretted that he had not ranked first in the first jia.

sentences.zh: 正隆二年會試畢，海陵以第一人程文問子聃，子聃少之。

translations.literal: When the second year of Zhenglong joint examination ended, Hailing asked Zidan about the first person's examination essay; Zidan belittled it.
translations.idiomatic: After the joint examination of the second year of Zhenglong, Hailing asked Zidan's opinion of the top candidate's essay, and Zidan disparaged it.

sentences.zh: 海陵問作賦何如，對曰：「甚易。」

translations.literal: Hailing asked how composing fu was; he replied: "Very easy."
translations.idiomatic: Hailing asked how he found composing fu; he replied, "Very easy."

sentences.zh: 因自矜，且謂他人莫己若也。

translations.literal: Thereby he prided himself, and moreover said others were not his equal.
translations.idiomatic: He grew boastful and declared that no one could match him.

sentences.zh: 海陵不悅，乃使子聃與翰林修撰綦戩、楊伯仁、宣徽判官張汝霖、應奉翰林文字李希顏同進士雜試。

translations.literal: Hailing was displeased and therefore had Zidan together with Hanlin Compiler Qi Kai, Yang Boren, Palace Attendant administrative aide Zhang Rulin, and Attendant for Hanlin Documents Li Xiyan take the jinshi mixed examination with others.
translations.idiomatic: Displeased, Hailing ordered Zidan to take a special jinshi examination alongside Hanlin compiler Qi Kai, Yang Boren, palace attendant administrative aide Zhang Rulin, and attendant for Hanlin documents Li Xiyan.

sentences.zh: 七月癸未，海陵禦寶昌門臨軒觀試，以「不貴異物民乃足」為賦題，「忠臣猶孝子」為詩題，「憂國如饑渴」為論題。

translations.literal: On guimou of the seventh month Hailing faced the Baochang Gate and observed the examination from the hall; taking "Not valuing strange objects, the people are then sufficient" as the fu topic, "A loyal minister is like a filial son" as the poetry topic, and "Worrying for the state like hunger and thirst" as the discourse topic.
translations.idiomatic: On guimou of the seventh month Hailing observed the examination from the Baochang Gate; the fu topic was "Not prizing strange objects, the people are content," the poetry topic "A loyal minister is like a filial son," and the discourse topic "Caring for the state as for hunger and thirst."

sentences.zh: 上謂讀卷官翟永固曰：「朕出賦題，能言之或能行之，未可知也。

translations.literal: The emperor said to examination reader Zhai Yonggu: "I set out the fu topic—whether those who can speak of it can also practice it is not yet known.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor told examination reader Zhai Yonggu, "In setting the fu topic, whether those who can write of it can also act on it remains to be seen.

sentences.zh: 詩、論題，庶戒 臣下。」

translations.literal: The poetry and discourse topics are to admonish the ministers below."
translations.idiomatic: The poetry and discourse topics are meant to admonish my ministers."

sentences.zh: 丁亥，禦便殿親覽試卷，中第者七十三人，子聃果第一，海陵奇之。

translations.literal: On dinghai he faced the side hall and personally viewed the examination papers; those passing numbered seventy-three; Zidan indeed ranked first; Hailing marveled at it.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai he personally reviewed the papers in the side hall; seventy-three passed, with Zidan first, to Hailing's astonishment.

sentences.zh: 有頃，進官三階，除翰林修撰。

translations.literal: Before long he advanced three ranks in office and was appointed Hanlin Compiler.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was promoted three ranks and appointed Hanlin compiler.

sentences.zh: 改侍御史。

translations.literal: He was changed to Attending Censor.
translations.idiomatic: He was made attending censor.

sentences.zh: 京畿旱，詔子聃決囚，遂澍雨，人以比顏真卿。

translations.literal: The capital region was drought-stricken; an edict had Zidan decide prisoners; then timely rain fell; people compared him to Yan Zhenqing.
translations.idiomatic: When the capital region suffered drought, Zidan was ordered to review prisoners, and timely rain followed; people compared him to Yan Zhenqing.

sentences.zh: 遷待制，兼吏部郎中，改秘書少監。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Awaiting Draftsman, concurrently Director of the Ministry of Personnel, changed to Vice Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to awaiting draftsman and concurrently director of the Ministry of Personnel, then vice director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 遷翰林直學士，兼太子左諭德，顯宗深器重之。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Hanlin Direct Academician, concurrently Crown Prince Left Mentor; Xianzong deeply valued and employed him.
translations.idiomatic: He became Hanlin direct academician and left mentor to the crown prince, and Xianzong held him in high regard.

sentences.zh: 以疾求補外，遂為沂州防禦使，皇太子幣贐甚厚，命以安輿之官。

translations.literal: Because of illness he requested an external post; he then became Yizhou defense commissioner; the crown prince's funeral gifts were very generous, ordering him to go to office in a comfort carriage.
translations.idiomatic: Seeking an external post because of illness, he became defense commissioner of Yizhou; the crown prince sent lavish parting gifts and ordered him to travel to his post in a comfort carriage.

sentences.zh: 召還，為左諫議大夫、兼直學士。

translations.literal: Recalled, he became Left Remonstrance Censor, concurrently Direct Academician.
translations.idiomatic: Recalled to court, he became left remonstrance censor and direct academician.

sentences.zh: 改吏部侍郎、同修國史，直學士如故。

translations.literal: He was changed to Vice Minister of Personnel, concurrently revising the national history; direct academician as before.
translations.idiomatic: He was made vice minister of personnel and compiler of the national history while retaining his post as direct academician.

sentences.zh: 遷侍講、兼修國史，上曰：「修《海陵實錄》，知其詳無如子聃者。」

translations.literal: He was transferred to Attendant Lecturer, concurrently revising the national history; the emperor said: "In compiling the 'Veritable Records of Hailing,' none knows the details like Zidan."
translations.idiomatic: Promoted to attendant lecturer and compiler of the national history, the emperor said, "In compiling the Veritable Records of Hailing, no one knows the details as Zidan does."

sentences.zh: 蓋以史事專責之也。

translations.literal: This was because the historical affairs were specially entrusted to him.
translations.idiomatic: This was because he was given sole charge of that historical work.

sentences.zh: 二十年，卒，年五十五。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year he died, age fifty-five.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year he died at the age of fifty-five.

sentences.zh: 子聃英俊有直氣，其為文亦然。

translations.literal: Zidan was handsome and possessed upright spirit; his composing prose was likewise.
translations.idiomatic: Zidan was handsome and upright in character, and his writing was the same.

sentences.zh: 平生所著詩文二千餘篇。

translations.literal: In his lifetime he composed more than two thousand pieces of poetry and prose.
translations.idiomatic: In his lifetime he wrote more than two thousand poems and essays.

sentences.zh: 党懷英

translations.literal: Dang Huaiying.
translations.idiomatic: Dang Huaiying.

sentences.zh: 党懷英，字世傑，故宋太尉進十一代孫，馮翊人。

translations.literal: Dang Huaiying, style name Shijie, was eleventh-generation descendant of the former Song Grand Marshal Jin, a native of Fengyi.
translations.idiomatic: Dang Huaiying, whose style name was Shijie, was an eleventh-generation descendant of the Song grand marshal Dang Jin and came from Fengyi.

sentences.zh: 父純睦，泰安軍錄事參軍，卒官，妻子不能歸，因家焉。

translations.literal: His father Chunmu was Taian Army recording affairs officer; he died in office; wife and children could not return and therefore made their home there.
translations.idiomatic: His father Chunmu served as recording affairs officer of the Taian army and died in office; unable to return home, the family settled there.

sentences.zh: 應舉不得意，遂脫略世務，放浪山水間。

translations.literal: In taking the examinations he was not satisfied; he then cast off worldly affairs and wandered freely among mountains and waters.
translations.idiomatic: After failing to succeed in the examinations, he cast off worldly affairs and wandered freely among mountains and streams.

sentences.zh: 簞瓢屢空，晏如也。

translations.literal: His bamboo basket and gourd were often empty; he was serene as ever.
translations.idiomatic: Though his basket and gourd were often empty, he remained perfectly at ease.

sentences.zh: 大定十年，中進士第，調莒州軍事判官，累除汝陰縣令、國史院編修官、應奉翰林文字、翰林待制、兼同修國史。

translations.literal: In the tenth year of Dading he passed the jinshi examination, assigned Juzhou military administrative aide, through successive removals made Yuyin county magistrate, National History Institute compiler, Attendant for Hanlin Documents, Hanlin Awaiting Draftsman, concurrently revising the national history.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year of Dading he passed the jinshi examination and was appointed military administrative aide of Juzhou; he rose through county magistrate of Yuyin, compiler at the National History Institute, attendant for Hanlin documents, Hanlin awaiting draftsman, and compiler of the national history.

sentences.zh: 懷英能屬文，工篆籀，當時稱為第一，學者宗之。

translations.literal: Huaiying could compose prose and was skilled in seal and zhou script; his age called him first, and scholars took him as their model.
translations.idiomatic: Huaiying was an accomplished writer and master of seal script; contemporaries ranked him first, and scholars took him as their model.

sentences.zh: 大定二十九年，與鳳翔府治中郝俁充《遼史》刊修官，應奉翰林文字移剌益、趙渢等七人為編修官。

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year of Dading he together with Fengxiang Prefecture administrative aide Hao Yi served as "History of Liao" publication revising officers; Attendants for Hanlin Documents Yelü Yi, Zhao Feng, and seven others were compilers.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-ninth year of Dading he and Hao Yi, administrative aide of Fengxiang, served as revising officers for the "History of Liao," with Yelü Yi, Zhao Feng, and seven other attendants for Hanlin documents as compilers.

sentences.zh: 凡民間遼時碑銘墓誌及諸家文集，或記憶遼舊事，悉上送官。

translations.literal: All among the people Liao-era stele inscriptions, tomb epigraphs, and various families' collected works, or memories of Liao old affairs, were all sent up to the authorities.
translations.idiomatic: All Liao-era stele inscriptions, tomb epigraphs, collected works, and memories of Liao affairs in private hands were ordered sent to the authorities.

sentences.zh: 是時，章宗初即位，好尚文辭，旁求文學之士以備侍從，謂宰臣曰：「翰林闕人如之何？」

translations.literal: At that time Zhangzong had just ascended the throne, fond of and esteeming literary compositions, broadly seeking literary scholars to prepare as attendants; he said to chief ministers: "The Hanlin lacks people—what is to be done?"
translations.idiomatic: When Zhangzong had newly ascended the throne, devoted to literary culture, he sought literary men for his entourage and asked his chief ministers, "The Hanlin lacks men—what is to be done?"

sentences.zh: 張汝霖奏曰：「郝俁能屬文，宦業亦佳。」

translations.literal: Zhang Rulin memorialized: "Hao Yi can compose prose; his official career is also excellent."
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Rulin replied, "Hao Yi can write well and has a fine official record."

sentences.zh: 上曰：「近日制詔惟党懷英最善。」

translations.literal: The emperor said: "Recently in edicts and rescripts only Dang Huaiying is best."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said, "Of late only Dang Huaiying writes the best edicts and rescripts."

sentences.zh: 移剌履進曰：「進士擢第後止習吏事，更不復讀書，近日始知為學矣。」

translations.literal: Yelü Lü advanced: "After jinshi selection and ranking they only study clerk affairs and no longer read books; only recently have they begun to know learning."
translations.idiomatic: Yelü Lü added, "After receiving their degrees jinshi study only clerkly affairs and read no more; only recently has Hao Yi turned to learning."

sentences.zh: 上曰：「今時進士甚滅裂，《唐書》中事亦多不知，朕殊不喜。」

translations.literal: The emperor said: "Nowadays jinshi are very slipshod; many matters in the 'Book of Tang' they also do not know—I am especially displeased."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said, "Jinshi of today are shockingly slipshod; many do not even know events recorded in the Book of Tang, and I am deeply displeased."

sentences.zh: 上謂宰臣曰：「郝俁賦詩頗佳，舊時劉迎能之，李晏不及也。」

translations.literal: He said to the chief ministers: "Hao Yi's fu poetry is quite excellent; in former times Liu Ying could do it; Li Yan did not reach that level."
translations.idiomatic: He then told the chief ministers, "Hao Yi composes fu poetry quite well; Liu Ying could do so in earlier days, but Li Yan fell short of that level."

sentences.zh: 明昌元年，懷英再遷國子祭酒。

translations.literal: In the first year of Mingchang, Huaiying was again transferred to Chancellor of the Directorate of Education.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Mingchang, Huaiying was again made chancellor of the directorate of education.

sentences.zh: 二年，遷侍講學士。

translations.literal: In the second year he was transferred to Attendant Lecturer.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year he was transferred to attendant lecturer.

sentences.zh: 明年，議開邊防濠塹，懷英等十六人請罷其役，詔從之。

translations.literal: The next year, when border-defense moats were proposed, Huaiying and sixteen others asked that the labor be stopped; an edict approved their request.
translations.idiomatic: The next year, when border-defense moats were proposed, Huaiying and sixteen others petitioned to halt the work, and the court approved their request.

sentences.zh: 遷翰林學士。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Hanlin Academician.
translations.idiomatic: He was made Hanlin academician.

sentences.zh: 七年，有事於南郊，攝中書侍郎讀祝冊，上曰：「讀冊至朕名，聲微下，雖曰尊君，然在郊廟，禮非所宜，當平讀之。」

translations.literal: In the seventh year, during the southern suburb sacrifices, acting as Vice Director of the Secretariat he read the sacrificial prayer book; the emperor said: "When reading the book and coming to my name, you lower your voice—though called reverence for the ruler, in suburban and temple rites this is not proper; you should read it evenly."
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year, during the southern suburb sacrifices, he served as acting vice director of the secretariat and read the sacrificial prayer book; the emperor said, "When you read the book and reach my name, you lower your voice. Though called reverence for the ruler, in suburban and temple rites this is improper; read it evenly."

sentences.zh: 承安二年乞致仕，改泰甯軍節度使。

translations.literal: In the second year of Chengan he asked to retire and was changed to Military Commissioner of the Taining Army.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Chengan he asked to retire and was made military commissioner of Taining.

sentences.zh: 明年，召為翰林學士承旨。

translations.literal: The next year he was summoned to serve as Hanlin Academician Expositor.
translations.idiomatic: The next year he was recalled as Hanlin academician expositor.

sentences.zh: 泰和元年，增修《遼史》編修官三員，詔分紀、志、列傳刊修官，有改除者以書自隨。

translations.literal: In the first year of Taihe, three additional compilers were appointed to augment revision of the "History of Liao"; an edict divided revising officers for annals, treatises, and biographies, with any change of appointment to be recorded in writing as they proceeded.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Taihe three more compilers were added to the revision of the History of Liao; an edict assigned revising officers to annals, treatises, and biographies, with any change of appointment recorded in writing as they worked.

sentences.zh: 久之，致仕。

translations.literal: Before long he retired.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he retired from office.

sentences.zh: 大安三年卒，年七十八，諡文獻。

translations.literal: He died in the third year of Da'an, aged seventy-eight; his posthumous title was Wenxian.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the third year of Da'an at the age of seventy-eight and was given the posthumous title Wenxian.

sentences.zh: 懷英致仕後，章宗詔直學士陳大任繼成《遼史》云。

translations.literal: After Huaiying retired, Zhangzong ordered Direct Academician Chen Daren to continue completing the "History of Liao," it is said.
translations.idiomatic: After Huaiying retired, Zhangzong ordered Hanlin direct academician Chen Daren to continue completing the History of Liao.
